35.text: She poured me a cup with a smile, then took a look down at the folder in front of me.

36.speaker: Livia Suno
36.text: "It looks like you have quite the packed agenda for today, Mr. President."

37.speaker: Livia Suno
37.text: "I'm sorry again about the disturbance my indiscretion caused. I hope it didn't create too much extra work for you."

38.speaker: Player
38.text: "Lucian's madcap accusations created the disturbance, not you."

39.speaker: Player
39.text: "It wasn't your fault. It was my lecher of a vice president."

40.speaker: Player
40.text: "I do expect more professional behavior from you going forward, Ms. Suno."

41.speaker: Player
41.text: "My work is none of your business."

42.speaker: Livia Suno
42.text: "You're absolutely right. My apologies, Mr. President. Enjoy your coffee."

43.speaker: Livia Suno
43.text: "And you will get it, Mr. President. Enjoy your coffee."

44.speaker: Livia Suno
44.text: "Don't be too hard on Petr. I was as reckless as he was."

45.speaker: Livia Suno
45.text: "He did seem to be trying to protect you, in his own way."

46.speaker: Narrator
46.text: I walked over and poured myself a cup. I wondered when my new secretary would start work.

48.speaker: Narrator

103.speaker: Lucian Galade
103.text: "But I did want to give you a quick word of warning."

104.speaker: Lucian Galade
104.text: "I have noticed that the USP faction in the Assembly has adopted a confrontational stance of late."

105.speaker: Lucian Galade
105.text: "Their displeasure with you has led them to engage in obstructionist tactics, slowing down policy implementation and creating legislative gridlock."

107.speaker: Player
107.text: "Damn. I really have turned into the next Alphonso, haven't I?"

108.speaker: Player
108.text: "I'll show them what happens when you get in the way of Anton Rayne."

109.speaker: Player
109.text: "Blocking progress for the country because of their petty disagreements with me. I hope they're happy with themselves."

110.speaker: Lucian Galade
110.text: "It means we will have a significantly harder time following through with our plans for this portion of the term, Mr. President."

111.speaker: Lucian Galade
111.text: "It won't be easy to get past this, I'm afraid.

112.speaker: Lucian Galade
112.text: "The Assembly did employ similar tactics to block your predecessor's reforms, yes."

113.speaker: Lucian Galade
113.text: "It is my hope that we're still able to follow through on some of our plans for this term. But it won't be easy."

115.speaker: Lucian Galade
